documents.text: Rotate an expiring credential by creating a replacement, updating the worker secret, verifying new authentication, and only then revoking the old key. Preserve queued work during the change.
A tenant snapshot restores the captured tenant state. Writes acknowledged after capture are outside that snapshot and need a separate replay or recovery mechanism.

When a tool commits its effect and the worker dies before saving the checkpoint, replay may attempt the tool again. A stable operation identifier and a unique effect ledger prevent a duplicate effect.
Conversation thread names and memory namespaces are routing identifiers. Derive their tenant component from authenticated application context; a caller-selected name is not authorization.
A private response cache must include trusted tenant, model, policy, and corpus versions. Similar questions alone do not establish that a cached answer is authorized or current.
Filtered approximate vector search can return too few neighbors when the tenant is rare. Verify actual query plans, iterative scanning, and an exhaustive in-tenant control.
Hybrid retrieval combines lexical matching of opaque identifiers with vector similarity. Exact ticket and error codes can distinguish otherwise similar operations documents.
An embedding model transforms text into vectors. The same vectors can be stored in different databases, so a better embedding model does not establish a better database.
Conversation recording and extraction of long-term facts are different stages. The background extractor may take time; observe a usable long-term memory instead of assuming immediate availability.
A corrected or deleted fact must disappear from semantic retrieval as well as direct lookup. Wait for search visibility and check that another tenant’s surviving memory is unchanged.
A database agent tool should use read-only operation and a scoped database identity. Disabling write tools does not grant permission to read every tenant.
The database region and model inference region are separate choices. Confirm the inference endpoint and key scope independently from the location of stored vectors.
Rotate an image in the document viewer using the toolbar. This changes the page orientation and does not update database credentials.
Take a screenshot of the dashboard to attach to a support ticket. A screenshot cannot restore database rows or replay writes.
Increase the CPU thread count when local inference underuses the processor. This setting does not identify a conversation or a tenant.
The operating system page cache stores recently read file blocks. Its contents are unrelated to authorization for cached language-model responses.

queries.text: How can we replace a soon-to-expire access key without losing waiting jobs?
Will restoring yesterday’s captured tenant data also recover an insertion acknowledged this morning?
What stops a tool from producing its effect twice if a process dies immediately after committing it?
Can someone gain access to another organization by choosing its conversation identifier?
Which context belongs in a key for reusing a private model answer safely?
Why can nearest-neighbor search miss the only surviving record for a very small tenant?
How can retrieval distinguish an exact error code when several notes have nearly the same meaning?
If we improve the text-to-vector model, must we switch the database too?
Does accepting a new chat message mean its long-term facts are already searchable?
After removing a stale preference, what else must we verify besides direct document lookup?
Does turning off mutating agent tools establish access control over every tenant’s information?
Does storing embeddings in Europe prove that the model processed the text in Europe?
